methodology.name: annual_budget_per_mile
methodology.note: Capital budget per mile of street per year.

methodology.name: breaks_per_mile_year
methodology.note: Expected water-main breaks per mile per year (N_target = this x miles). BWSC reports just over 35 failures a year (docs/budget_agent_reference.md); not yet divided by BWSC miles of main.

methodology.name: proposal_fraction
methodology.note: Share of segments each agent may propose on.

methodology.name: central_proposal_fraction
methodology.note: Share of segments the central planner scans.

methodology.name: reserve_max_fraction
methodology.note: Cap on the simulated reserve as a share of the budget.

methodology.name: reserve_fraction
methodology.note: Fixed reserve; used only when reserve_mode is fixed.

methodology.name: urgency_full_prob
methodology.note: Yearly failure probability that scores urgency 1.0.

methodology.name: critical_facility_multiplier
methodology.note: Urgency boost for a critical facility.

methodology.name: urgent_cap_fraction
methodology.note: Tier 1 work may use at most this share of the spendable amount.

methodology.name: urgent_override
methodology.note: Urgency at or above this is Tier 1 and can be funded below the hurdle.

methodology.name: min_return
methodology.note: Return hurdle per dollar.

methodology.name: dig_fixed
methodology.note: Cost to open one street segment, paid once per opening (evidence_plan.md priority 1).

methodology.name: pipe_per_ft
methodology.note: Pipe work cost per foot.

methodology.name: repave_per_ft
methodology.note: Repaving cost per foot.

methodology.name: reline_frac
methodology.note: Relining cost as a share of replacement.

methodology.name: emergency_multiplier
methodology.note: A failure repair costs this multiple of planned replacement.

methodology.name: discount_rate
methodology.note: Discount rate.

methodology.name: cost_inflation
methodology.source: MassDOT FY27-31 CIP p.58 (asphalt +40% over five years, about 7% a year)
methodology.checked: 2026-10-31 (as recorded in docs/assumptions_register.md; original not re-read here)
methodology.note: Cost inflation per year.

methodology.name: department_split
methodology.note: Fixed pipe/road shares, isolated baseline only.

methodology.name: c_social_max
methodology.note: Dollar cost of a worst-case failure (social cost).

methodology.name: u0
methodology.note: Road user cost, dollars per vehicle-mile at worst condition.

methodology.name: lam
methodology.source: Range 0.06 to 0.6 stated by the team from the literature; value is ASSUMPTION
methodology.note: Share of pavement life lost per cut.

methodology.name: L
methodology.note: Resurfacing cycle in years.

methodology.name: H_replace
methodology.note: Benefit horizon of a replacement, years.

methodology.name: H_reline
methodology.note: Benefit horizon of a reline, years.

methodology.name: rho
methodology.note: Share of pipe age removed by relining.

methodology.name: H_preserve
methodology.note: Benefit horizon of pavement preservation.

methodology.name: rho_preserve
methodology.note: Share of pavement age removed by preservation.

methodology.name: preserve_frac
methodology.note: Preservation cost as a share of a repave.

methodology.name: reconstruct_mult
methodology.note: Reconstruction cost as a multiple of a repave.

methodology.name: reconstruct_bonus_years
methodology.note: Extra years of like-new condition after reconstruction.

methodology.name: pof_band
methodology.note: PoF bounds: x0.85 and x1.15 + 5 (the rubric has no error bar).

methodology.name: road_benefit_band
methodology.note: Road benefit bounds, plus or minus this share.

methodology.name: P_min
methodology.note: PCR at or below which a road is Failed.

methodology.name: funding_mix
methodology.note: Share of each year's spendable amount by source.

methodology.name: loan_terms.interest_free_loan
methodology.source: BWSC CIP p.18 (MWRA LWSAP, interest-free, 10 years)
methodology.note: Interest-free loan terms.

methodology.name: loan_terms.srf_loan
methodology.source: Term from BWSC CIP p.18 (20 to 30 years, below market); rate 2% and 25 years chosen by the team
methodology.note: State revolving loan terms.

methodology.name: loan_terms.bonds
methodology.note: Bond rate and term.

methodology.name: rate_revenue_eligible_work
methodology.source: BWSC CIP p.17: renewal and replacement, including main relining (docs/budget_agent_reference.md). Relining added by decision; interfaces.md listed replace_pipe and repave only
methodology.note: Work that rate revenue may pay for.

methodology.name: era_old
methodology.note: When pipes were mostly laid, older neighborhoods.

methodology.name: adt_range
methodology.note: Traffic range by road class.

methodology.name: street_network
methodology.source: Analyze Boston Street Segments (SAM) + MassDOT Road Inventory (data/SOURCES.md)
methodology.note: Street geometry, names, lengths, classes (REAL). Everything on and under the streets is simulated.

methodology.name: reserve_share
methodology.source: Derived: 95th percentile of simulated yearly emergency cost ($177,719,292) over 5 pilot seeds = 4.41 of the budget, capped by reserve_max_fraction
methodology.note: Share of the annual capital budget set aside for emergency repairs.
